record.incident_summary: a workflow patch silently failed to apply while the commit message claimed the step existed
conditions: text patching by anchor match, without verifying the anchor exists in the file
the operator chain continued past the patch's assertion failure — one failed command did not stop the chain
the commit message was written from intent, not from the diff
downstream CI failure was detected only manually
root_causes: success signals (a completed command, a written message) were trusted without verifying the artifact they claimed to have produced
assumptions: the anchor text matched the file content
an assertion failure halts the surrounding chain
a described change and an applied change are the same thing
trigger_factors: the workflow step was renamed between drafting and applying the patch
environmental_factors: shell operator chains without fail-stop semantics
behavioral_factors: describing intent is easier than verifying state, so it happens instead of verification

antibodies.name: operator-chain-fail-stop

antibodies.mitigation: fail-stop chains or explicit verification gates between mutations and claims
